scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.test: npm run test:runner && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:web && npm run test:python
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:contracts && node scripts/python-runner.mjs -m ruff check packages/contracts/python packages/contracts/tests scripts/export-contract-schema.py services
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:contracts && node scripts/python-runner.mjs -m mypy packages/contracts/python packages/contracts/tests services/api/src services/api/tests services/worker/src services/worker/tests
